metadata.title: Markov-driven self-similar measures and non-homogeneous slicing
metadata.abstract: We introduce the concept of Markov-driven self-similar measures, a notion that simultaneously generalizes classical self-similar measures, self-conformal measures, dynamically driven self-similar measures and many random measures. This class is also closed under Cartesian products and linear projections. We initiate the study of this class of measures and investigate the $L^q$ dimension of Markov-driven self-similar measures under certain Diophantine conditions. As an application, we obtain the first Furstenberg slicing type results for intersections of Cantor sets in non-homogeneous settings.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: Markov驱动自相似测度与切片
analysis.workSummary: 作者定义Markov驱动自相似测度，统一经典自相似、自共形、动力驱动及多种随机测度，且该类对Cartesian积及线性投影封闭。在一定Diophantine条件下研究L^q维数，并应用于非齐性Cantor集交的Furstenberg型切片结果。
analysis.breakthrough: 把既有切片机制推进到非齐性设置，并给适于积和投影的共同测度类别。
analysis.limitations: 维数和切片结论依赖具体Diophantine假设；框架包含许多测度不意味着每个成员自动满足所证维数公式。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第6页AI statement明确LLM用于文献综述、起草部分技术陈述的证明及检查数学正确性；作者核验并大幅重写生成内容。声明同时强调Markov自相似测度及通过最坏情形谱研究Lq维数等主要思想由作者在2025至2026年初独立获得，因此不标ideas。第15页类似AI的字母为数学记号。
